transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because my head’s been feeling cloudy. At work, I’ll look at a board packet or a vendor email, and I just… can’t seem to decide even simple things. Stuff I used to handle pretty quickly is taking me a long time now.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve been sad exactly… maybe just kind of worn down or frustrated because things feel harder than they should.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
I don’t really know. I wouldn’t say I’ve been anxious exactly… maybe a little tense sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed it as anxiety.
Have you been feeling sad or empty inside?
I don’t know that I’d call it empty. I haven’t really noticed that feeling. It’s more like I’m just tired of not being able to think things through like I usually do.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do?

Not really, no. I usually like going to my dance class, looking at the little galleries, cooking Sunday food for my family… those things usually make me feel like myself. Lately I just haven’t wanted to do them.
Do you still get pleasure from the things you do?

Not much, no. Even when I try, it doesn’t feel the same. Like dance class, the little galleries, cooking Sunday food for my family… those usually make me feel like myself, and lately I just don’t really want to do them.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?

I haven’t really been checking my weight, but my eating’s been off. Some days coffee and just a few bites get me through most of the day, then at night I’ll pick at tortillas or sweets, but I’m not really enjoying it.
Do you often worry about things that are coming up or things that might happen?
I’m not sure. I mean, I think about things I need to do, but I haven’t really noticed if I’m worrying a lot about what might happen.
Do you often feel on edge?

Yeah, sometimes. At home I feel slowed down, like my legs are heavy and I’m moving through mud. But then in meetings I notice I’m tapping my pen or shifting around in the chair, like I’m too keyed up to just sit still.
Do you fear that things will never get better?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought of it that way. I have rough days, but I can’t say I’m sitting there thinking it’ll never get better.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things even when there's no obvious reason to worry?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get concerned when there’s something real going on, but I haven’t noticed myself worrying for no reason.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things in general, even when everything seems to be going well?
Not really, no. If things are going okay, I’m usually not sitting around worrying. I might think about normal stuff, but not like it takes over.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two weeks now. It started after my husband retired and was suddenly home all day, and that’s when I noticed the change in my energy and confidence, and then that low, cloudy feeling.
Have you been feeling hopeless lately?
I’m not really sure I’d call it hopeless. I’ve felt down, but I don’t think I’ve been feeling like there’s no way forward.
How long have you noticed that you don't enjoy things you usually like to do?
It’s been about two weeks, I’d say. Around when my husband retired and was home all day, that’s when I noticed this change.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks?
I’m not sure I’d say most of the day, nearly every day. I’ve felt low off and on, but I haven’t really been keeping track that closely.
Have you been feeling depressed for at least two weeks?
Yes, about two weeks. That sharper change—my energy and confidence dropping, and that low, cloudy feeling—started around when my husband retired and was suddenly home all day.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed for most of the day?
I don’t think it’s been most of the day. I’ve had sad spells, but it kind of comes and goes.
Would you say you've lost interest in activities you usually enjoy most of the time over the past two weeks?

Yes… I’d say so. I haven’t really wanted to go to my dance class, or go look at the little galleries like I usually do. Even cooking Sunday food for my family just feels like too much, and those are things that normally make me feel like myself.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past two weeks?

I don’t know if I’ve lost a significant amount, I haven’t really checked. But my eating has been off. Some days coffee and just a few bites get me through most of the day, and then at night I’ll pick at tortillas or sweets, but I’m not really enjoying it.
